### Power Point - Sept. 1, 2006
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-sept-1-2006-1419484.html
Passage: Nehemiah 4:6
Points:
- Hurtful words can cause deep discouragement and emotional pain.
- Satan relies on deceit to undermine believers' confidence and halt their progress.
- Just as Nehemiah faced enemies who mocked the rebuilding effort, Christians face attacks when seeking renewal.
- Recognizing the enemy's lies and trusting God enables believers to persevere and succeed.

### What God Is Building Through All the "Inefficiencies" of Life
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/what-god-is-building-through-all-the-inefficiencies-of-life
Passage: Nehemiah 4:1-8
Points:
- Believers are often bewildered when opposition and setbacks slow down kingdom work.
- When Nehemiah's workers had a mind to work, hostile leaders arose to jeer and intimidate them.
- Time and resources spent facing adversity are never wasted in God's economy.
- God uses opposition and interruptions to turn human self-reliance into dependent faith.
- Enduring trials ultimately builds genuine trust in God, which is far more valuable than efficient productivity.
